title: Abrupt destination replacement
observed: IndexedStack changes the painted page immediately while only the navigation indicator animates.
impact: The touched destination and arriving content lack visual continuity.
proposal: Use a brief interruptible transition without remounting tab state.
verification: Pinned Flutter 3.47.2: 18 retained-tab/navigation tests, 10 targeted capability/glass/accessibility/text-scale tests, and 14 capture cases passed; 16 PNGs inspected selectively. Scoped Dart analyzer and format passed. No ADB or measured frame-time claim.

title: Inactive tabs retain ticker and focus eligibility
observed: No per-tab TickerMode or explicit focus exclusion surrounds mounted destinations. Hidden work indicators may keep ticking; runtime cost was not measured.
impact: Avoidable offscreen animation and possible focus ownership make switching less predictable.
proposal: Only the selected destination may tick, receive focus/input or expose semantics; keep all destination state mounted.
verification: Pinned Flutter 3.47.2: 18 retained-tab/navigation tests, 10 targeted capability/glass/accessibility/text-scale tests, and 14 capture cases passed; 16 PNGs inspected selectively. Scoped Dart analyzer and format passed. No ADB or measured frame-time claim.

title: Dock spends too much height on internal hit-box accounting
observed: Integration height formula counts 48dp for the icon plus label and 20dp spacing; default AppTheme yields an approximately 84dp dock. The icon indicator itself is 32dp. Runtime screenshot 42 is baseline, not proof of integration geometry.
impact: Navigation consumes more vertical space than the visible controls need, competing with task content.
proposal: Target 72dp at normal text with at least 8dp painted icon clearance and 4dp label-bottom clearance; grow only when fitted label metrics require it.

title: Dock rail differs from the page rail
observed: Dock has 12dp side insets; coordinated page/content rail target is 16dp.
impact: Visible edges fail to align through the daily Workspace-to-navigation flow.
proposal: Use 16dp visible dock edges; coordinate a quiet Workspace action tray with 12dp total inter-region gap.

title: Connection traffic repeats navigation font measurements
observed: Each rebuild constructs two TextPainters per destination even when labels, width and typography are unchanged.
impact: Unnecessary layout work is performed during unrelated status updates; actual frame-time impact is unmeasured.
proposal: Cache label metrics by width, label content, text direction and resolved selected/unselected styles.

title: Glass name overstates the painted material
observed: The dock uses 96% tint opacity and a 16dp shadow blur over an unextended solid body; there is no backdrop sampling.
impact: Extra translucency adds no useful content relationship and can be mistaken for actual glass behavior.
proposal: Use an honest solid tonal surface, quiet edge and shallower 8dp shadow; retain strong opaque accessibility treatment.
verification: Pinned Flutter 3.47.2: 18 retained-tab/navigation tests, 10 targeted capability/glass/accessibility/text-scale tests, and 14 capture cases passed; 16 PNGs inspected selectively. Scoped Dart analyzer and format passed. No ADB or measured frame-time claim.

title: Partial label styles measure differently from their rendered text
observed: At 320dp and 2.5x, the partial navigation label style inherited body font metrics while TextPainter used defaults. Workspace wrapped to two lines and extended below the dock.
impact: Navigation text clipping and crowded icon clearance undermine the primary destination control.
proposal: Resolve the partial navigation style against the localized label role, then use that identical style for text measurement and painting.
